old_caption: The video captures a serene beach scene at sunset. The sky is painted with vibrant hues of orange, yellow, and blue, transitioning into darker shades as it meets the horizon. Wispy clouds are scattered across the sky, reflecting the warm colors of the setting sun. The ocean waves gently lap against the shore, creating a rhythmic sound that adds to the tranquil atmosphere. The water on the beach reflects the colorful sky, enhancing the visual beauty of the scene. There are no visible characters or animals in the video; the focus remains solely on the natural elements. The camera remains stationary throughout the sequence, allowing viewers to fully absorb the peaceful and picturesque moment.

caption: The video captures a wide beach scene under a layered sunset sky of orange, gold and teal clouds, with a bright sun glow near the center-right horizon. A band of surf runs horizontally across the middle of the frame, where low white foam crests continuously roll and reshape toward the shore. The foreground is a flat sheet of wet sand mirroring the warm and cool tones above, its reflection patches shimmering and reorganizing as the thin water film moves over the ripples. The cloud formations and horizon line hold their positions, showing no visible drift within this window. The camera stays fixed, keeping the horizon height and composition steady. Small waves keep breaking and receding along the surf zone. The still sky and glowing reflection persist throughout.
